target_customer: Developers and companies running long lived AI agents that need a full Linux machine
problem: Agents need full computers with persistent disks, desktop access and browsers rather than short lived code sandboxes. InstaBox provides Firecracker microVM Linux machines per agent.
business_model: Usage-based cloud compute with subscription tiers: Free, Pro 20 per month, Builder 100, Team 500 and Enterprise, plus charges for vCPU, memory, storage and egress
product_category: Cloud computers and sandboxes for AI agents

founders.name: Hang Huang
previous_startups: Co-founder of InsForge, a separate YC company, per the YC page bio
founders.background_notes: Per YC page, which also says he was a professional League of Legends player. The bio is the InsForge bio and may be mislabeled for InstaBox.

founders.name: Tony Chang
previous_startups: Co-founder of InsForge per the YC page bio
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; hackathon winner. Same caveat about the InsForge bio.

competitors.name: E2B
competitors.what: Firecracker microVM sandboxes for AI agents
competitors.traction_then: Fortune 100 customers claimed by the company

competitors.name: Daytona
competitors.what: Agent sandbox and runtime platform that shifted from dev environments in 2025
competitors.funding_then: 24M Series A led by FirstMark reported February 2026 by a comparison site

technical_complexity.rationale: Running Firecracker microVMs with snapshots, persistent disks, ports and desktop views is established technology but requires solid infrastructure engineering to run at low cost.

defensibility.rationale: Many funded sandbox providers sell similar microVM products, and comparison sites list numerous alternatives, so copying is easy and differentiation is thin.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to say. Well funded players already offered the same wedge when the batch started.

market_need_then: Agent builders increasingly need isolated execution environments, and E2B and Daytona both raised Series A rounds after 2025. The product site shows pricing live but no customers.

branding.domain_note: Uses instabox.sh, a .sh developer domain rather than a .com.

identity.logo: not described by any source seen
identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and product focused; the site gives specs and pricing and no brand narrative.

brand_strength.rationale: The name is confusable with Instabox, a Swedish parcel locker company, Instaboxx, and many Insta named developer tools, and searches found no brand press.

outcome_analysis: InstaBox is a Spring 2026 YC company selling Linux cloud computers to AI agents in a crowded sandbox market. Its YC page carries bios tied to InsForge, so the team relationship is unclear, and no funding, customers or traction are public. The outcome cannot be judged.
notes: The YC page bios list both founders as co-founders of InsForge and include an InsForge launch post. InsForge reportedly raised an 8M seed (Dealroom news); that is not recorded as an InstaBox round because the relationship is unconfirmed. No InstaBox funding was found. Founded year is not stated on the page seen. The Swedish parcel company Instabox and its 2022 Dutch bankruptcy is unrelated. Daytona funding comes from a comparison site and is unverified. Searches found no acquisition, shutdown or layoff news for the AI company.
